title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Cloudflare
providers.scope_notes: Covers Cloudflare (API, Zero Trust Access, R2). All plans have API tokens and 18-month Audit Logs v2; Logpush beyond 18 months is Enterprise; Access service tokens need Cloudflare Zero Trust; R2 credentials need R2.

controls.name: Leaked token detection (GitHub Secret Scanning)
controls.what: Tokens leaked in public GitHub repos are auto-revoked; private-repo leaks only notify.

controls.name: Change Global API Key
controls.what: Replaces the user's Global API Key.
controls.setting: My Profile > API Tokens > API Keys > Change

controls.name: Enable API Access / API Access (member-level)
controls.what: Enterprise Super Administrators can turn off API access for the whole account or for specific members; member settings override the account setting.
controls.setting: Members page > Enable API Access; per member: API Access

no_control.what: No IP restriction or expiry for the Global API Key.
Global API Key cannot be limited to specific resources or permissions.

controls_unknown: Any account-level setting to block members from creating user API tokens or using the Global API Key.
Any account-wide policy forcing token expiry or IP filters.
Whether Super Administrators can list or revoke other members' user API tokens.
Whether dashboard SSO or Access policies are checked on API token / Global API Key requests (no explicit statement).
Exact Audit Logs v2 action names for token create/delete/roll.
Whether Origin CA keys still authenticate after the 2026-09-30 removal date.
IP restrictions for Access service tokens and for R2 S3 requests.
Cloudflare OAuth tokens (actor context 'oauth', e.g. Wrangler) were not researched.

authentication.summary: One key per user (cfk_ prefix for new/rolled keys), sent with X-Auth-Email and X-Auth-Key headers; has every permission the user has on every resource.

federation.details: No doc ties Global API Key use to dashboard SSO.

ip_restriction.boundary: Docs list lack of IP and time limits as a Global API key limitation.

renewal.summary: Change (roll) the key under My Profile > API Tokens > API Keys.

administration.summary: Available once the account email is verified. No documented admin setting to disable Global API Keys for members.

offboard.details: The key has exactly the user's permissions, so removing the member's account access removes the key's access to that account.

inventory.details: No admin list of Global API Keys found; key use shows in audit logs with actor.context api_key.

inventory.api: GET /accounts/{account_id}/logs/audit?actor_context=api_key (lists users whose Global API Key was used; no key list exists)

reads.ui: Manage Account > Audit Logs > set Action type = view

offboard.ui: Manage Account > Members > expand member > Revoke > Yes, revoke access

token_format.notes: New/rolled keys cfk_; older keys 37-45 char lowercase hex.

credential_id_fields.notes: api_key; no token_id (field only set for api_token/oauth)

lifecycle_events.notes: Key change event name not documented

anomaly_cues: Any api_key context activity if you have migrated to tokens

containment.steps: Change the Global API Key in My Profile > API Tokens.

unknown: Whether key change is audit logged

calls.log_notes: Logged as a view action in Audit Logs v2; actor.context is api_key with the user's actor.email/id (no per-key ID).
